sealed.statement: A failed replica-removal cleanup can no longer strand orphaned DB/WAL files indefinitely: the existing idempotent retry path (reconcileRemovedReplicaCleanup) gains a durable owner — either a cleanup-debt record persisted before terminalizing, and/or a startup filesystem sweep comparing the partitions directory against authoritative rows (the sweep also catches historical orphans) — so the retry becomes reachable; today the coordinator terminalizes on the completion event and nothing ever deletes an orphan. Verified-audit finding 12 (confirmed worse than the audit claimed). doneWhen: the test-receipt probe reads solve/evidence/removed-replica-cleanup-debt-owner.receipt.json with outstanding 0 — cleanup-retry-reachable-after-failure and orphan-files-eventually-deleted receipts passing (deterministic red-on-revert evidence harness).

constraints.statement: Choose and record in a finding: persist a cleanup-debt record before terminalizing, add a startup filesystem sweep, or both. The sweep variant must also catch historical orphans; the debt-record variant alone does not.
Each new regression test must fail when the chosen owner mechanism is reverted (retry unreachable / orphan undeleted) while the rest of the change remains.
If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

claim: explicit-choice: (b) startup filesystem sweep alone. A removal-cleanup failure strands exactly one thing — replica DB/WAL/SHM files under <dataDir>/partitions whose authoritative services row is already gone — and the filesystem itself is the complete, crash-durable record of that debt; a control-plane debt record adds no information the sweep does not already read and would fail closed (row insert fails -> retry lost) precisely where the sweep is already running at startup. The sweep variant also catches historical orphans (row-less files predating any debt mechanism), which a debt record cannot. Implemented as ReplicaHandler.initialize() -> sweepRemovedReplicaCleanupDebt() (src/node/replica-handler-removed-cleanup-sweep.js) comparing on-disk <partitionId>/<replicaId>.db files against services rows for this node and driving the canonical reconcileRemovedReplicaCleanup per row-less file set; reconcile was made to delete files unconditionally (previously skipped file deletion when no tracked service existed — the latent half of finding 12, verified red-on-revert both ways). Quarantined reconciliation evidence is never re-deleted; failed deletions stay on disk and are retried next startup; unreadable partitions dir fails closed (skip + warn).

hypothesis: Cleanup-debt durable owner via startup filesystem sweep (audit finding 12; explicit-choice recorded = option b sweep alone): ReplicaHandler.initialize() now kicks off sweepRemovedReplicaCleanupDebt (src/node/replica-handler-removed-cleanup-sweep.js), which lists on-disk <partitionId>/<replicaId>.db files, subtracts assigned authoritative SERVICES rows for this node, and drives the canonical idempotent reconcileRemovedReplicaCleanup per row-less file set — so the retry has a permanent owner and becomes reachable (today the coordinator terminalizes on the completion event and nothing deletes an orphan). The sweep keys on ABSENCE of an authoritative row, so it also catches HISTORICAL orphans (files orphaned before any debt mechanism), never touches assigned or quarantined files, and fails closed on an unreadable partitions dir; per-file deletion failure leaves files in place for next-startup retry. Latent bug fixed (the worse-than-audit half): reconcileRemovedReplicaCleanup previously skipped file deletion entirely when no tracked service existed — exactly the post-restart orphan shape — so even a reachable retry would not have deleted the orphan; file deletion is now unconditional. Sweep-alone chosen over a control-plane debt-record because the filesystem IS the complete crash-durable debt record (a debt row adds no information and would fail closed on insert failure where it matters most). Red-on-revert verified (sweep-wiring revert + tracked-service-only cleanup-guard revert each flip the suite red); 23-assertion suite; 2/2 receipts; replica-handler(318)+cleanup/removal suites green; source already committed under 2d1cade2a (swept by sibling Q6 land); independent verifier APPROVED (evidence subagent:ses_0236f5a0bffeCpev3sFdYpixRf).
